第 144 章 雁门关大捷龙国震动（第1页）
第二天清晨，雁门关大捷的消息，如同长了翅膀一般，传遍了九州大地。
“什么？破晓君王被斩杀了？鹰国主力军团全军覆没？”
“真的！是真的！九人封神战队打败了六绝猎杀大阵，亲手杀了破晓君王！”
“太好了！我们终于赢了！龙国有救了！”
各地的百姓们自发地走上街头，敲锣打鼓，庆祝胜利。原本低迷的龙国气运，强势回升。天空中，一条金色的巨龙虚影若隐若现，发出震耳欲聋的咆哮。
各路义军、残存的修士、民间的义士，听到消息后，纷纷奔赴雁门关归附。短短三天时间，雁门关就聚集了数十万大军。龙国的反抗势力，空前壮大。
雁门关内，众人正在举行一场简单的祭奠仪式。
他们将巨灵神和所有牺牲的士兵们，安葬在了雁门关外的山坡上。
庄周站在墓碑前，手中拿着一杯酒，缓缓洒在了地上。
“巨灵神，各位兄弟，你们安息吧。我们守住了雁门关，我们赢了。以后，再也不会有人能欺负我们了。”
众人纷纷鞠躬，向牺牲的英雄们致敬。
柳若兮抱着小蝶，站在人群的最后面。她看着墓碑上一个个陌生的名字，眼泪忍不住流了下来。
她终于明白，这场胜利，是用多少人的生命换来的。
祭奠仪式结束后，众人回到了关内。
悟空和哪吒正在指挥士兵们修补城墙，清理战场。
杨戬和后羿在养伤，后羿虽然脱离了生命危险，但需要很长时间才能恢复。
神农女依旧昏迷不醒，庄周每天都会用蝶力为她疗伤，希望能让她早日醒来。
张二狗和申公豹则在整理缴获的物资，研究鹰国的机甲技术，希望能为龙国打造出自己的机甲军团。
柳若兮看着忙碌的众人，目光最终落在了庄周的身上。
庄周正站在地图前，和几位将领商议着下一步的作战计划。他的脸上依旧是那副波澜不惊的样子，仿佛昨天那场惊心动魄的大战，与他毫无关系。
他没有像悟空、后羿那样，站在台前接受大家的欢呼和崇拜。他依旧默默地站在幕后，运筹帷幄，为龙国的未来谋划着。
柳若兮的心中，充满了复杂的情绪。
她依旧崇拜那些光芒万丈的强者，依旧会为悟空、后羿的高光时刻而激动。
但她也终于明白，庄周才是整个战队的灵魂。没有他的推演布局，没有他的舍命相护，他们根本不可能取得这场胜利。
可她还是不明白，为什么庄周总是甘愿站在幕后，为什么他总是把所有的光芒都让给别人。
这份困惑，如同种子一般，在她的心底生根发芽，越来越深。爱慕中夹杂着疏离，不解中带着依赖，让她的心，变得无比混乱。
庄周似乎察觉到了柳若兮的目光，他转过头，对着柳若兮微微一笑。
柳若兮心中一惊，连忙低下头，脸颊微微泛红。
就在这时，一名士兵跑了进来，兴奋地禀报：“庄周大人！好消息！南方的义军已经收复了三座城池，西方的黑日国军队也停止了进攻，开始撤退了！”
庄周点了点头，脸上露出了一丝欣慰的笑容。
“传我命令，全军休整三日。三日之后，兵分三路，全面反攻！”
众将领齐声应道，眼神中充满了斗志。
阳光透过窗户，洒在庄周的身上，为他镀上了一层金色的光芒。
龙国，终于从被动逃亡防守，转向了主动反攻的全新格局。
而那些埋藏在心底的情感与困惑，也将在未来的战火中，迎来最终的答案。

Chapter 144 The Great Victory of Yanmen Pass shocked the Dragon Kingdom (page 1)
Early the next morning, the news of the great victory at Yanmen Pass spread throughout the land of Kyushu as if it had wings.
"What? The King of Dawn was beheaded? The main army of the Eagle Kingdom was completely wiped out?"
"It's true! It's true! The nine-member Conferred Gods team defeated the Six Ultimate Hunting Formation and killed the Dawn King with their own hands!"
"Great! We finally won! The Dragon Kingdom is saved!"
People from all over the country spontaneously took to the streets, beating gongs and drums to celebrate the victory. The luck of the Dragon Kingdom, which was originally sluggish, has rebounded strongly. In the sky, a golden dragon loomed, making a deafening roar.
After hearing the news, rebels from all walks of life, remaining monks, and civilian volunteers rushed to Yanmen Pass to surrender. In just three days, hundreds of thousands of troops gathered at Yanmen Pass. The resistance force in the Dragon Kingdom has grown unprecedentedly.
Inside Yanmen Pass, everyone was holding a simple memorial ceremony.
They buried the Giant Spirit God and all the sacrificed soldiers on the hillside outside Yanmen Pass.
Zhuang Zhou stood in front of the tombstone, holding a glass of wine in his hand and slowly spilling it on the ground.
"Giant Spirit God, brothers, rest in peace. We defended Yanmen Pass, and we won. No one will be able to bully us again in the future."
Everyone bowed to pay tribute to the fallen heroes.
Liu Ruoxi held Xiaodie and stood at the back of the crowd. She couldn't help but shed tears as she looked at the unfamiliar names on the tombstone.
She finally understood that this victory was achieved at the cost of many lives.
After the memorial ceremony, everyone returned to the pass.
Wukong and Nezha are directing the soldiers to repair the city wall and clean up the battlefield.
Yang Jian and Hou Yi were recovering from their injuries. Although Hou Yi was out of danger, it would take a long time to recover.
Shen Nong Nu was still unconscious, and Zhuang Zhou would use butterfly power to heal her injuries every day, hoping to wake her up soon.
Zhang Ergou and Shen Gongbao were sorting out the captured materials and studying the Eagle Kingdom's mecha technology, hoping to build their own mecha army for the Dragon Kingdom.
Liu Ruoxi looked at the busy people, and finally her eyes fell on Zhuang Zhou.
Zhuang Zhou was standing in front of the map, discussing the next battle plan with several generals. His face still had that calm look, as if yesterday's thrilling battle had nothing to do with him.
He did not stand in front of the stage and accept everyone's cheers and worship like Wukong and Houyi. He still stood silently behind the scenes, strategizing and planning for the future of Dragon Kingdom.
Liu Ruoxi's heart was filled with complex emotions.
She still admires those dazzling strong men, and is still excited by the highlight moments of Wukong and Hou Yi.
But she finally understood that Zhuang Zhou was the soul of the entire team. Without his deduction plan and his sacrifice of life to protect them, they would never have been able to achieve this victory.
But she still didn't understand why Zhuang Zhou was always willing to stand behind the scenes, why he always gave up all the light to others.
This confusion, like a seed, took root in her heart and grew deeper and deeper. Admiration mixed with alienation, confusion mixed with dependence, making her heart extremely confused.
Zhuang Zhou seemed to notice Liu Ruoxi's gaze. He turned his head and smiled at Liu Ruoxi.
Liu Ruoxi was shocked and quickly lowered her head, her cheeks turning slightly red.
At this moment, a soldier ran in and reported excitedly: "Lord Zhuang Zhou! Good news! The rebels in the south have recaptured three cities, and the Black Sun army in the west has also stopped attacking and begun to retreat!"
Zhuang Zhou nodded, with a relieved smile on his face.
"Pass my order to rest the entire army for three days. After three days, the troops will be divided into three groups and launch a full-scale counterattack!"
All the generals responded in unison, their eyes full of fighting spirit.
The sun shines through the window and onto Zhuang Zhou's body, coating him with a layer of golden light.
The Dragon Kingdom finally shifted from passive escape defense to a new pattern of active counterattack.
And those emotions and confusions buried deep in the heart will also usher in the final answer in the future war.
